sloka: ततः कृत्वा महर्षीणां यथार्हमभिवादनम् ।तत्र चैकां निशामुष्य यास्यामस्तां पुरीं पुनः ।। ७.४६.३० ॥
transliteration: tataḥ kṛtvā maharṣīṇāṁ yathārhamabhivādanam ।tatra caikāṁ niśāmuṣya yāsyāmastāṁ purīṁ punaḥ ।। 7.46.30 ॥

translations.english: Then, after appropriately saluting the great sages and staying there for one night, we will return to that city (Ayodhya) again.
